## Type of change

- [ ] Editorial (typography, links, formatting; no change in meaning)
- [ ] Clarification to a specification
- [ ] Erratum to a specification, schema or test vector
- [ ] Proposal for a future version
- [ ] Reference implementation or tests
- [ ] Implementation report (`conformance/implementations/`)

## Checklist

- [ ] Normative changes were agreed in an issue first (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] The specification's change history (Appendix A) and CHANGELOG.md are updated, where applicable.
- [ ] Tests, examples and test vectors are added or updated for any change to a schema or a normative rule.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass.
- [ ] Each commit is signed off under the Developer Certificate of Origin (`git commit -s`).
